description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for the SmsManager class in a Kotlin-based Android project. The tests cover parsing of SMS parameters, message building, normalization of phone numbers, handling of SQL LIKE literals, selection string building, message comparison logic, pagination, and metadata construction related to SMS and MMS messages. It validates both internal logic and external interactions, ensuring robustness and correctness of SMS/MMS management functionalities.
